Action: Total Frames	Total Frames of a skill/attack (counting for hitlag)
Frame Perfect Buffer	The exact frame the game transitions into a new move (doesn't count for hitlag)
Hit Instance/s	How many hits there are in a skill/attack
HitLag	How many frames a hit slows down an animation
Earliest Frame Until Cancel	The earliest frame until you can cancel a move with all hit instance/s hitting (not including Ult Cancel unless specified)
Frames Until Last Hit Instance	The exact frame until the last hit instance collides with the enemy
Endlag	Total Frames - Earliest Frame Until Cancel
EndSkill	The frame wherein the game considers this skill as "over"
Invincible (f)	How many frames a resonator is invincible (cannot be damaged)
NoInterruption (f)	How many frames a resonator is immune to interruption
NoSwap (f)	How many frames a resonator is not able to swap into another resonator
QTE (f)	How many frames a skill is considered an Intro Skill
Dodge (f)	How many frames a skill is considered a Dodge Skill
Time Stop (f)	How many frames time is stopped
Enemy Stop (f)	How many frames enemies are stopped
